races.paceDynamic: Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic will clash from the gates, both natural front runners who dictate from the front. With only seven runners and two confirmed pace-setters, they'll establish a solid gallop over this 1m2f trip, likely going steady early before quickening from halfway. The honest tempo will stretch the field out, creating gaps for closers but requiring them to be positioned handy turning for home. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers and midfield runners who can track the leaders without getting too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic engage in a sustained duel through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for horses racing in behind, with the leaders weakening in the final furlong as closers sweep past. Prominent trackers like Pantile's Gift are ideally placed to inherit the lead when the pace-setters fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders establishes a soft lead while the other settles or struggles early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with less pressure on the front runner, allowing them to dictate terms and prove hard to peg back. Sovereign Bright's recent form suggests he can sustain a strong gallop when uncontested.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go steady early before quickening, creating the ideal stalking scenario
scenarios.body: Pantile's Gift can track the leaders perfectly positioned under Hollie Doyle, using her superior recent form to strike at the optimal moment. The tactical setup allows prominent runners to time their challenge without getting caught too wide or deep.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer's Dream Setup
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with both leaders committed to the gallop from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo will find out the leaders' stamina reserves over this extended trip, setting up a dramatic finish for the hold-up horses. Due To Shine's return from a long break could be perfectly timed if the race develops into a staying test.

watchPoints.text: Meritocratic's fitness after 112 days off - if he's not ready, the pace scenario changes completely with only Sovereign Bright to set the gallop.
Early positioning of Pantile's Gift - Hollie Doyle must avoid getting caught wide tracking the leaders around the turn.
Project Kinsman's finishing effort - his tendency to fade late could be exposed again if asked to make up significant ground.
Due To Shine's market support given the lengthy absence - any betting moves would suggest hidden fitness work.
The gap that opens up behind the pace-setters - if it becomes too large, the closers will struggle to make up the ground in time.

races.paceDynamic: Fille Unique will lead from the gates with Northern Tempest, Taaklam, Stromness, Anorah Unleashed, Cosmic Clarets, Full Gas and Brain Freeze all showing prominent tendencies creating genuine early pressure. This clustered pace-setting group will ensure a strong gallop from the off, stretching the field and putting the pure hold-up horses like Marra Donna, Thornaby Annie, Mademoiselle Belle, Carnation Queen, Forever Twenty and Pivotal Terms at a significant disadvantage. The sustained tempo over 6f on Newcastle's sharp track will favour horses that can sit handy and quicken rather than those needing to come from the back. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid the early scrum but stay close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the seven pace-oriented horses all go forward creating genuine pressure from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The strong tempo will find out the weaker prominent runners but perfectly suit the classier horses who can sit just off the pace like Marra Donna and Anorah Unleashed. The hold-up horses will face an impossible task from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If several of the prominent runners settle more than expected, allowing Fille Unique an easy lead
scenarios.body: A moderate tempo will bring the hold-up horses into play, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Mademoiselle Belle and Pivotal Terms. The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fille Unique Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique gets first run and the prominent pack fails to apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested advantage and her recent consistent form will prove decisive from the front. Late closers will have too much ground to make up on the sharp Newcastle track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses interfere with each other or go too fast too early
scenarios.body: Chaos in the early stages allows a patient ride from the back to pay dividends, with the strongest finishers coming through late. Only horses with proven ability to quicken from off the pace will benefit.

watchPoints.text: Fille Unique could steal this if the other prominent horses fail to press her early and she gets loose on the lead
Watch for traffic problems with seven horses wanting to be prominent - several could get shuffled back at crucial moment
Marra Donna's hold-up style is dangerous here but her class edge could prove decisive if getting clear run
Anorah Unleashed with Hollie Doyle aboard represents strong trainer/jockey combination hitting form
The long-absent runners Taaklam, Thornaby Annie and Carnation Queen all need to prove fitness first time back

races.paceDynamic: Wicket Keeper will be the sole early pace angle with Paddy's Day, Evening Saigon, and William Dewhirst sitting prominent. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce with only one confirmed leader, allowing the prominent trio to track comfortably. A large group of hold-up horses including Toyotomi, Albasheer, Strike Red, The Caltonian, Grant Wood, and Cajetan will need to mount late challenges. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can avoid traffic and kick from ideal positions behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Wicket Keeper sets steady fractions without pressure from the gate
scenarios.body: The prominent trio of Paddy's Day, Evening Saigon, and William Dewhirst can position perfectly and outkick the hold-up brigade. The hold-up horses face a wall of runners and come too late against the well-positioned pace trackers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too early or the pace quickens beyond sustainable levels
scenarios.body: The experienced hold-up performers like Albasheer and Grant Wood can capitalize on pace collapse with superior finishing kicks. Hollie Doyle's timing on Albasheer or Grant Wood's recent winning form could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wicket Keeper Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Wicket Keeper gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old builds an unassailable lead with soft fractions and holds off all late challenges. Recent course form at Newcastle gives confidence in his ability to stay the trip under pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Wicket Keeper goes too slow early creating a sprint finish from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with the most natural speed like The Caltonian or Toyotomi can unleash devastating late kicks. This turns into a pure speed test rather than a tactical affair.

races.paceDynamic: Showcasing Star will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed leaders, setting a comfortable pace that suits his proven stamina at this trip. Eddaari and Sovereign Bay are likely to track closely in second and third, with the hold-up horses Far Far Out, Too Darn Spicy and Alembic needing to overcome the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind. The uncontested lead scenario creates a moderate tempo that won't set up strongly for closers. This race shape favours prominent racers and the lone front-runner, as they can control the gallop and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Showcasing Star Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Showcasing Star gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent form
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back, with prominent trackers Eddaari and Sovereign Bay battling for the places. His two recent seconds at this trip on similar going give him tactical and form advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Eddaari or Sovereign Bay press Showcasing Star early to prevent a soft lead
scenarios.body: The increased pace will suit the hold-up horses more, particularly the unexposed newcomers Far Far Out and Heathers Feather who can finish strongly. Eddaari's higher rating makes him the most likely beneficiary if he can secure the right position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomers Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Far Far Out or Heathers Feather possess significant unexposed ability given their connections
scenarios.body: Roger Varian's Far Far Out with Jack Mitchell could have classic potential that overcomes the tactical disadvantage, while the moderate pace helps stamina-laden types. Both arrive fresh and lightly raced with scope for improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and sets up perfectly for closers
scenarios.body: Too Darn Spicy gets the 5lb claim from Cam Hardie and has shown some ability, while the strong pace would expose Showcasing Star's stamina reserves. The mathematics suggest this is unlikely given the lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.trigger: If The Cookstown Cafu gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace leaves plenty in the tank for those up with the pace while the hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed. Prominent racers like Sassy Glory can track the leader and pounce late while front-runners get away with murder in the slow early sections.

scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup as early leaders fade after battling through the middle stages. Mercurius Power and Barleybrown benefit from their strong finishing kicks and good recent form.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If The Cookstown Cafu stops quickly after a long layoff and no other pace emerges
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no clear tempo, suiting versatile sorts who can adapt to the changing circumstances. Lady Delila's recent good form and ability to race anywhere becomes crucial in a muddling contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Falaise Blanc Springs Surprise

scenarios.body: Falaise Blanc benefits from being 11lbs lighter than the main dangers and gets first run on the hold-up horses. Her previous course win and light weight could see her spring a surprise at big odds.

The prominent brigade of Darlo Pride, Herakles, Blue Force, Ganesha and Zuffolo will track behind but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. This sets up a tactical affair where the hold-up horses Dc Cogent, Rock Of England, Brian The Snail and Bonito Cavalo will need to weave through traffic in the final two furlongs. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hover On The Wind gets soft early fractions and isn't pressured
scenarios.body: The leader will have plenty left in the tank for the final furlong while the field struggles to make up ground in a sprint finish. Front runners and those tracking closest benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: Darlo Pride or Blue Force can use their higher ratings to quicken past a tired leader in the final 100 yards. The pace-tracking tactics pay dividends when the front runner weakens.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to set up closers
scenarios.body: Dc Cogent's higher rating and Paul Mulrennan's steering could see him weave through to land the spoils. Brian The Snail might also benefit from a truly-run race given his hold-up style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely creating a lottery finish
scenarios.body: Zuffolo returning from a 137-day break could benefit from the others going too slow early before producing fresh speed. Ganesha might also capitalize if the race becomes messy and tactical.
